svg.title: ROV-GND-P4 at true 50 millimeter PCB scale
svg.desc: Exact single millimeter coordinate scale across all illustrated components. GH footprints from KiCad: 4P courtyard 9.44x6.60, 6P courtyard 11.96x6.60. FPC 15P width 19.70. GPIO pins 2.54mm pitch in thirteen rows, outermost column at x48mm.
svg.text: Every drawn component uses the same millimeter coordinate system
SCALE TEST: 13 GPIO rows = 30.48 mm; FPC = 19.70 mm; GH4 plastic = 8.25 mm.
The GPIO row span is 60.96% of the 50 mm PCB height; the FPC width is 39.40% of board width.
1:1 at 100% SVG print size. Corner holes / power / microSD opposite-side clearance remain under review.
Shown: GH KiCad exact courtyard and fab sizes; FPC manufacturer body size; GPIO precise hole-center spacing.
Missing: vendor-verified FPC and USB PCB land patterns, PHY/magnetics, regulators and completed PCB routing.
